Frequently Asked Questions

Yes, absolutely! Apna app is completely free for all job seekers. You can search, apply, and save jobs without any charges.

Follow these steps to apply for a job using Apna app.
1. Download the Apna app from Google Play Store
2. Log in using your phone number, complete your profile, and select city.
3. Select the job categories that match your skills
4. Find the job of your choice and apply
5. Call HR to schedule an interview

You can find a wide range of vacancies, including Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Mechanical and Electrical Site Execution Manager, Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Site Lead, so on. Whether you're a fresher or an experienced professional, Apna features best job opportunities in various sectors.

Salaries can vary greatly depending on the industry, experience level, and specific role. The average salary of some companies ranges from ₹20000 to ₹80000 monthly and you can find detailed salary information by referring to the dedicated job salary section.

Apna is a leading platform for finding your dream jobs in India, it connects thousands of job seekers with top companies and offers a diverse selection of job opportunities across various industries.

Some of the top companies currently hiring for new job vacancy include: The Walt Disney Company, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Jones Lang Lasalle Property Consultants India Pvt Ltd, Mongodb Software India Private Limited, Zscaler Softech.

The minimum experience needed to apply for jobs varies widely depending on the company, industry, and specific role. While some active positions may prefer 0 year work experience and you can easily find jobs that match your experience level by using the search and filter options on the platform.

You can create a free job alert on the Apna app, this way you’ll receive instant updates on the latest vacancies directly in your inbox.
